mainEntity.name: Should I choose a built-in grill or a full custom outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in grill is usually the better choice if you want a simpler, lower-cost upgrade with fewer moving parts. A full custom outdoor kitchen makes more sense when you want storage, prep space, refrigeration, and a design that matches the house and yard. The right option depends on how often you cook outside and how much of the space you want to dedicate to entertaining. Built-in setups are easier to keep compact, while custom kitchens offer more flexibility and better long-term usability. Think about whether you need just a cooking station or an actual outdoor living hub. That distinction usually makes the decision much easier.
